description: This file is a CMake module script designed to locate and configure the systemd library for a build system. It checks for the presence of systemd using pkg-config, finds necessary libraries and headers, and sets up imported targets for use in CMake projects.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Finds and configures the PkgConfig package for systemd.

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: Checks for the presence of the systemd package via pkg-config.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Finds the header file 'sd-daemon.h' for systemd.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes additional CMake modules, such as FindPackageHandleStandardArgs.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Handles standard arguments for package finding and validation.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Creates an imported library target for systemd.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets properties for the imported systemd library target.
